title: Philochorus
summary: Raleigh names Philochorus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Philochorus, also printed Philocorus, who placeth Homer after Troy and saith Homer preceded Hesiod. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XVI, §. VII, sig. 291b–292a
